info.title: Bancadia Business Checking API
info.summary: Compare U.S. business checking accounts with structured filters.
info.description: Read-only JSON API over Bancadia's registry of verified business checking account products. No API key is required; an optional bearer token raises rate limits and attributes usage to your developer account. Responses are slim: a missing field means not offered or not published. Use - in place of {listing_slug} to read across all listings. Every bank row's application_url is a tracked Bancadia link: give it to the user exactly as returned, including its query string.

get.description: Find business checking accounts matching filter criteria. Returns up to limit rows (default 7, max 20, clamped; the effective limit is in meta.limit); page with offset and meta.next_offset. data is an array of rows; paging and extras (total_matches, matches_overview, excluded_by, possible_matches) are in meta. Select more columns with fields. Array parameters are comma-separated. Unknown parameters return 400. Every bank row's application_url is a tracked Bancadia link: give it to the user exactly as returned, including its query string.

get.summary: Search fee and feature details across all listings
get.description: Full-text search of fee and feature details across banks (e.g. 'zelle', 'overdraft'). Returns the best snippets per bank with application_url. Terms are ANDed; 'or', "quotes", -exclude work. data is the hits array; scanned, banks_matched, no_match and unknown_slugs are in meta. Use - in place of {listing_slug} to read across all listings. Every bank row's application_url is a tracked Bancadia link: give it to the user exactly as returned, including its query string.

parameters.name: slugs
parameters.description: Only these listing_slugs; banks without a hit go in no_match

parameters.name: topic
parameters.description: fees, payment_rails, cash_handling, cards_and_atm, online_banking, fraud_protection, account_management, platform_integrations or other

parameters.name: per_bank
parameters.description: Snippets per bank, 1-5, default 2

parameters.name: max_banks
parameters.description: Banks returned, 1-20, default 10

parameters.name: max_chars
parameters.description: Snippet length, 40-600, default 220
